name: functionCall-bench-eval
description: Benchmark for evaluating an LLM's function-calling behavior: selecting the correct function name and producing correctly structured arguments (often as JSON) given a natural-language or contextual prompt. Measures fidelity to an API schema, argument correctness, and robustness across varied prompts. Useful for assessing model reliability when integrated with tools and external APIs.
reputation: Niche Hugging Face dataset aimed at function-call evaluation; modest community adoption mostly among tool-integration researchers and practitioners.
